summary: 3.7.8–3.7.9 stop logging request bytes and credentials, fix a matcher hang on slim DST zone files, and print mock-miss paths in full on the console instead of in receipts.
3.7.3–3.7.7 fix IPv6 hosts in test targets and Docker/Compose port maps, installer/sudo Docker retries, MySQL pipelining, and mock-sync drops. Adds named worker-mock rules served to every test.
3.7.2 uses the Docker CLI's current context (Rancher Desktop) and no longer records HTTP streams as test cases. 3.7.1 fixes agent PID mapping, loopback ports, `//path` parsing, and MySQL mock errors.
Adds a parser-contract for mock-noise and miss reporting. Reusable mocks now keep the union of learned `req_body_noise`, so saved mock files can change (#4943).
